name: currency-converter
description: Root scripts that run the API and the web app together. Each app stays an independent npm package with its own lockfile; this is not a workspace.

scripts.setup: concurrently --group --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix apps/api ci" "npm --prefix apps/web ci"
scripts.dev: npm run infra:up && concurrently --kill-others --names api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix apps/api run start:dev" "npm --prefix apps/web run dev"
scripts.infra:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d --wait redis mongo
scripts.lint: concurrently --group --names api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix apps/api run lint" "npm --prefix apps/web run lint"
scripts.typecheck: concurrently --group --names api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix apps/api run typecheck" "npm --prefix apps/web run typecheck"
scripts.format:check: concurrently --group --names api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix apps/api run format:check" "npm --prefix apps/web run format:check"
scripts.test: concurrently --group --names api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix apps/api test" "npm --prefix apps/web test"
scripts.build: concurrently --group --names api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix apps/api run build" "npm --prefix apps/web run build"
